messages:
alex (Finance): Hey team — Nimbus Health flagged their Oct renewal invoice. Platform fee line doubled compared to last term, and they think support tier proration wasn't applied. Can someone pull context?

marta (AE): saw this earlier. they downgraded from Enterprise+ to Enterprise in June (EO ticket #9876). Renewal date 2024-10-01. I believed we pro-rated, but invoice shows full platform fee for both old+new tiers.

jordan (Billing): pulling invoice 554321... I see two platform_fee SKUs: PLATFORM-FEE-ENTPLUS and PLATFORM-FEE-ENT, both billed. looks like system didn't dedupe.

priya (CS): confirmed with customer — they approved downgrade on 2024-06-17 via email (attached in CS ticket).

ben (Eng Ops): deployment id nimbus-prod-1 still had reserved capacity pools pinned until 2024-09-30; our infra didn't auto-scale down. usage logs: `reserved_gpus: 24 -> 8` effective 2024-10-01. So backend change > billing cutover mismatch.

alex (Finance): OK that explains double charge. Nimbus is asking for a true-up credit for July-Sep where they kept lower support but were billed high? they want credit for the overlap (approx $18k).

jordan (Billing): need SOW/order form and exact effective date to compute pro-rate. can you upload to billing drive or paste order id? also need GL code for credit (rev_acct 4002?)

marta (AE): order id ORD-92834 in SF. I'll paste SOW link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/ORD-92834 — customer signed 2024-06-17.

priya (CS): attaching CS ticket ref: CS-2345 with email thread. customer explicitly said "downgrade effective immediately".

alex (Finance): thanks. Jordan, can you run a pro-rate calc and propose one-time credit amount? If <= $25k I can approve. If >$25k need finance director sign-off.

jordan (Billing): running calc now. quick note: because reserved capacity wasn't reduced until 10/01, billing system treated capacity as active for Jul-Sep at old price.

jordan (Billing): calc done — overlap charge = $21,450. Suggested credit = $21,450.

marta (AE): can we offer a goodwill reduction to $18k to preserve relationship?

alex (Finance): ok approve up to $20k. please issue credit of $20,000 and note remaining $1,450 as one-time discount pending ops follow-up. update GL 4002 and add memo 'onprem true-up goodwill 2024'.

jordan (Billing): will issue credit and update invoice. credit memo will reference INV-554321 and ORD-92834. logging action in billing system. :+1:

ben (Eng Ops): I'll schedule a config change to ensure reserved capacity changes trigger billing sync. filed infra ticket INF-667.

alex (Finance): thanks. Priya/Marta, confirm message to customer offering $20k credit and ops fix timeline?

priya (CS): will message them now.

marta (AE): i'll follow up in account call tomorrow.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2024-1001 created for INV-554321 amount $20,000.

alex (Finance): done — closing thread once credit posts. :white_check_mark:
